svg.title: Nennung von Kompetenzen nach Rollenfamilie
svg.desc: Jede Rollenfamilie nennt ihre eigene Mischung: BI nennt Visualisierung am häufigsten (86 %), Data Science KI-Formulierungen (82 %), Data Engineering SQL (69 %). Anteil in % der Inserate jeder Rollenfamilie. SQL: Data Engineering 69, Data Science 36, Business Analysis 13, Data Analytics 38, BI 52, Data Governance 14, Marketing-Analytics 54. KI (allgemein): Data Engineering 28, Data Science 82, Business Analysis 24, Data Analytics 21, BI 31, Data Governance 23, Marketing-Analytics 42. Datenvisualisierung: Data Engineering 33, Data Science 22, Business Analysis 17, Data Analytics 65, BI 86, Data Governance 19, Marketing-Analytics 50. Python: Data Engineering 55, Data Science 73, Business Analysis 3, Data Analytics 26, BI 11, Data Governance 9, Marketing-Analytics 13. Governance/Qualität: Data Engineering 44, Data Science 17, Business Analysis 9, Data Analytics 28, BI 18, Data Governance 82, Marketing-Analytics 50. Cloud (allgemein): Data Engineering 45, Data Science 48, Business Analysis 6, Data Analytics 17, BI 26, Data Governance 8, Marketing-Analytics 29. ETL/ELT: Data Engineering 60, Data Science 22, Business Analysis 1, Data Analytics 8, BI 17, Data Governance 3, Marketing-Analytics 8. Azure: Data Engineering 38, Data Science 34, Business Analysis 2, Data Analytics 8, BI 14, Data Governance 5, Marketing-Analytics 0. Power BI: Data Engineering 19, Data Science 5, Business Analysis 2, Data Analytics 34, BI 51, Data Governance 8, Marketing-Analytics 33. Excel: Data Engineering 6, Data Science 6, Business Analysis 14, Data Analytics 47, BI 20, Data Governance 26, Marketing-Analytics 38. Statistik: Data Engineering 3, Data Science 29, Business Analysis 3, Data Analytics 19, BI 11, Data Governance 12, Marketing-Analytics 25.
